content.text: For the sake of consistency, I am inclined to also movie UncheckedBiFunction out of fcrepo-kernel-api, too. It is only ever used in fcrepo-http-commons, so perhaps that's where it should go?
, moving UncheckedBiFunction to fcrepo-http-commons sounds reasonable.
The following PR has compilation errors... likely needs to be updated based on other recent code changes.
The fcrepo-module-auth-webac PR is in better state now.

org.fcrepo.kernel.api.utils.UncheckedFunction<T, R> and org.fcrepo.kernel.api.utils.UncheckedPredicate<T> import javax.jcr.RepositoryException. Either they should be generalized or they should be moved to fcrepo-kernel-modeshape.
